pinpoints.change: Key is correlationKey alone when parentContext is null — fold the parent's own identity (parent collection key / parent match id) into the composite so two parents with the same correlation value cannot share a childRegistry entry.
Returns parentContext: null unconditionally, emitting a value-only routing key; stamp the parent identity into INCLUDES_ROUTING here too.
Partition key falls back to bare correlationKey when __parentContext is absent — same completeness fix so per-parent limit/offset windows do not merge.

parentProjection is built only from refs that a parent-referencing WHERE clause happens to mention; it must capture every parent dimension that distinguishes two correlated instances, not just filter-referenced ones.
Declares parentFilters/parentProjection as the whole parent-side contract; widen it to carry the parent identity the routing key needs.
Reference implementation — already appends __correlationKey so groups from different parents cannot collide; the includes routing key must match this discipline.
Owns the key-completeness contract: the whole key object is normalized (plain-object keys sorted) into the hash, never a partial projection that matchQuery/matchMutation happens to filter on.
Lookup and dedup are done purely on the complete hash from hashQueryKeyByOptions — the shape the DB routing key must adopt.
Owns the contract: the cache key is `${endpointName}(${stableStringify(queryArgs)})` — the producing endpoint is folded in alongside the computed value, exactly the dimension DB's routing key drops.
Owns the contract: a grouped row's id is `${columnId}:${groupingValue}` prefixed with `${parentId}>` so equal grouping values under different parents never collide.
Owns the contract: the default row key joins parent.id with index rather than using index alone, keeping sibling subrows distinguishable.
Owns the contract: lookup keys are registered at nodeId, nodeId-type and nodeId-type-handleId so a connection is never found by a partial key that ignores a distinguishing dimension.
Connection key is `${sourceNode}-${sourceHandle}--${targetNode}-${targetHandle}` — every dimension of both endpoints, not just the node ids.

Counterexample that makes the omission legible: the family's param-to-atom lookup is decided entirely by areEqual, so a comparator narrower than the param's distinguishing dimensions silently returns another param's atom.
